# UGen catalogue (generated by tools/ugen_catalog.py)

278 UGens with documentation on this machine, grouped by category. Search it with `tools/ugen_catalog.py --find <regex>`.

## Libraries

- **AtsAmp** — Use Amp data from a given partial
- **AtsFile** — For working with ATS file data
- **AtsFreq** — Use Freq data from a given partial
- **AtsNoiSynth** — Resynthesize sine and noise data from an ATS analysis file
- **AtsParInfo** — One UGen to return both Amp and Freq info
- **AtsSynth** — Resynthesize sine data from an ATS analysis file
- **Balance** — Balances two signals with each other
- **BFDecode1** — 3D Ambisonic decoder
- **BFEncode1** — Ambisonic B format encoder
- **BFEncode2** — Ambisonic B format encoder
- **BFEncodeSter** — Ambisonic B format encoder for stereo signals
- **BFManipulate** — BFormat sound manipulation
- **BufGrain** — Granular synthesis with sound sampled in a buffer
- **BufGrainB** — Granular synthesis with sound sampled in a buffer and user supplied envelope
- **BufGrainI** — Granular synthesis with sound sampled in a buffer and user supplied envelopes
- **FMGrain** — Granular synthesis with FM grains
- **FMGrainB** — Granular synthesis with FM grains and user supplied envelope
- **FMGrainI** — Granular synthesis with FM grains and user supplied envelopes
- **FMHDecode1** — Decode an FMH signal for a specific speaker
- **FMHEncode1** — Second Order Ambisonic encoder
- **FMHEncode2** — Second Order Ambisonic encoder
- **LPCSynth** — Utilize LPC data
- **LPCVals** — Utilize LPC data
- **Maxamp** — Tracks and prints amplitudes
- **Metro** — Metronome
- **MonoGrain** — Granulates real-time input
- **MonoGrainBF** — Granulates real-time input with Ambisonic panning
- **MoogVCF** — Moog  filter emulation
- **PanX** — Equal power pan across an array of speakers
- **PV_BinBufRd** — Plays FFT data to a memory buffer
- **PV_BinDelay** — Delay and Feedback on a bin by bin basis.
- **PV_BinPlayBuf** — Plays FFT data to a memory buffer
- **PV_BufRd** — Plays FFT data from a memory buffer
- **PV_EvenBin** — Return the even numbered bins in an FFT buffer
- **PV_Freeze** — Freeze FFT frames
- **PV_FreqBuffer** — Store FFT data in another buffer for other use
- **PV_Invert** — Invert FFT frames
- **PV_MagBuffer** — Store FFT data in another buffer for other use
- **PV_MagMap** — Remap magnitudes to a new mag curve
- **PV_MaxMagN** — Return the N strongest bins
- **PV_MinMagN** — Return the N weakest bins
- **PV_NoiseSynthF** — Return only bins that are unstable
- **PV_NoiseSynthP** — Return only bins that are unstable
- **PV_OddBin** — Return the odd numbered bins in an FFT buffer
- **PV_PartialSynthF** — Return only bins that are stable
- **PV_PartialSynthP** — Return only bins that are stable
- **PV_PlayBuf** — Plays FFT data to a memory buffer
- **PV_RecordBuf** — Records FFT data to a memory buffer
- **PV_SpectralEnhance** — A harmonic enhancer
- **PV_SpectralMap** — Maps the spectral envelope of one FFT process onto another
- **PVInfo** — Return mag and freq data from a CSound pv
- **PVSynth** — Resynthesize Csound PV data
- **SinGrain** — Granular synthesis with sinusoidal grains
- **SinGrainB** — Granular synthesis with sinusoidal grains and user supplied envelope
- **SinGrainBBF** — Granular synthesis with sinusoidal grains with Ambisonic panning and user supplied envelope
- **SinGrainBF** — Granular synthesis with sinusoidal grains with Ambisonic panning
- **SinGrainI** — Granular synthesis with sinusoidal grains and user supplied envelopes
- **SinGrainIBF** — Granular synthesis with sinusoidal grains with Ambisonic panning and user supplied envelopes
- **WarpOverlap** — Create a texture of Warps
  - args: `numChans, buffer, overlaps, starttime, stretch, harm, windowsize, step, warpwindowsize, warpwindowoverlaps, warpwindowran`
- **WarpZ** — Warp a buffer with a time pointer
